message.text:
The top level of the input JSON file is an array. Each of these array items represents a seperate chat session containing a series of messages and responses as well as other data. We want a function to be used in a command line utility (node, deno, or bun CLI) to split the input into multiple output files each containing one of the input top level array items. 

The output files should be named automatically based on content within the JSON they store.

The sessionName function generates an apropriate name based on the session data. It works well but in what ways could it be improved? Is there better ways to write the javascript?
